hook: Your dawn in Cappadocia fills the sky with balloons.
title: Turkey's sunrise sky full of balloons
description:
At dawn in Cappadocia, Turkey, hot-air balloons rise above rock chimneys made of volcanic rock. On busy mornings hundreds can fly together, and the sight is famous around the world. Part of the series 'Places That Shouldn't Exist'.

#Shorts #Cappadocia #Travel
